notes:
## Keyboard navigation

Use the arrow keys or Tab across all eleven Settings pages. Closing a picker or search returns focus to the control you came from. Backspace edits text fields, and Enter submits the TV pairing code.

## iPhone pairing

The PIN now works throughout the two-minute window shown on the PC. In **Settings → iPhone**, select **Pair an iPhone** first. Then open **Apple TV Remote** in Control Center, select your PC and enter the code. Canapey also checks which Windows window is in the foreground and shows the connection status while Settings loads.

## Update

On an updater-enabled Windows x64 installation, open **Settings → Updates → Check for updates**, then choose **Download and install**. The Companion interoperability test covers delayed PIN entry and reconnection. Physical iPhone pairing still needs confirmation.
